# P8: What students say about early lessons

Citation: Adeyemi, F. (2022). Youth Voices, 3(1), 9-22.
Type: interviews (n = 36 students, three schools)

Abstract: Interviewed students described falling asleep in first lessons and skipping breakfast to catch early buses. Many said they would use a later start to sleep longer, but some worried about late finishes clashing with part-time jobs.

My notes: Short and readable. No numbers, so it only adds colour.
